title: Indian Shoe Size Chart: UK, US, EU and cm Conversion, Plus What the 'Bha' System Is
seoTitle: Shoe Size Chart India: UK, US, EU and cm, Men and Women
seoDescription: Shoe size chart for India: men's, women's and kids' UK, US, EU and foot length in cm from Adidas, Nike and Nivia charts, plus the status of the Bha system.
excerpt: Three real brand charts side by side, showing where Adidas, Nike and Nivia disagree, how to measure your foot in cm at home, and why the CSIR-CLRI Bha system still isn't on shoe labels.
